\chapter{Methods}\label{ch:methods}

\section{Model}
Let $p_t$ denote the price of a binary contract at time $t$. Then
\begin{equation}\label{eq:price}
  p_t = \E\left[ \mathbf{1}\{X = 1\} \mid \mathcal{F}_t \right].
\end{equation}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:martingale}
The price process $(p_t)$ is a martingale with $\Var{p_t} \le \tfrac14$.
\end{theorem}
